job.title: Investment Banking Analyst
job.descriptionHtml:
About MACA Advisors

MACA Advisors is a boutique investment bank advising market leaders and institutional investors across Latin America and the Caribbean. We deliver senior-led execution, cross-border expertise, and rigorous financial analysis through a nimble platform rooted in client alignment, transparency, and trust.

Role Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated Analyst to join our advisory team. This is an entry-level role ideal for candidates looking to start a career in investment banking. As an Analyst, you will support the execution of M&A and capital advisory transactions across various industries, while working closely with senior team members and gaining exposure to high-profile clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain detailed financial models and valuation analyses

  • Assist in preparing client presentations, information memorandums, teasers, and other deliverables

  • Conduct market research, company analysis, and industry benchmarking

  • Support deal execution through due diligence, data room management, and stakeholder coordination

  • Collaborate with Analysts, Associates, and senior leadership on active mandates

  • Demonstrate curiosity and initiative in learning core investment banking skills

Required Qualifications

  • Strong academic background in finance, economics, business, or related field

  • Excellent analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint

  • Clear and effective communication skills (Spanish and English fluency required)

  • Located in Latin America

Preferred Qualifications

  • Internship experience in investment banking, private equity, consulting, or related fields

  • Familiarity with the Latin America and Caribbean markets

  • Interest in sectors such as infrastructure, consumer, TMT, financial services, or industrials

What We Offer

  • Hands-on learning and mentorship from experienced bankers

  • Exposure to live deals and cross-border transactions

  • Accelerated development within a lean, entrepreneurial team

  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives

  • Remote-first flexibility with strong regional integration

Application Process

We evaluate candidates through a structured multi-round process, including:

  • Case-based assessment

  • Fit interviews with team members

  • Final round with senior leadership
